cohort: 14 pregnant women with type 1 diabetes treated with continuous subcutaneous insulin infusion and continuous glucose monitoring between 2011 and 2015.
finding: Continuous subcutaneous insulin infusion with continuous glucose monitoring was associated with a median A1c decrease of 1.02% but pregnancy complications such as gestational hypertension and macrosomia were frequent.
gest_age: Median gestational age at birth was 37 weeks and 4 days
